comments.text:
It’s crazy what he got away with, but three things stood out to me: that he’s not a great writer, that the hospital never called him directly, and that doctors have no power to send a body to be cremated.

He didn’t seem to realise that no hospital would fail to immediately contact next of kin, especially if a pregnancy involved. They HAVE to contact next of kin because they don’t have the authority to release the body if they have a next of kin contact. The only exception would be if there was no next of kin and no known family to claim the body, in which case they would be the morgue’s problem. 

Generally unclaimed bodies are kept around for a while just in case someone is found but I’ve only ever heard of the morgue releasing bodies to government plots for burial. I’ve never heard of unclaimed bodies being cremated in the US.

Hell, in a premature birth situation they’d have called him long before she died, because of him being the husband AND the father. So even if he weren’t next of kin there’s no way he wouldn’t have been contacted directly by the hospital when things went downhill so he could say goodbye to them both while she’s still alive.

He really is an awful writer (and liar) with those bus-sized plot holes he left for all to see.

For those of you blindly believing every word LE says, it’s SO important to remember that they’re simply GUESSING at much of what they say, especially at the early stages of an investigation. And this applies to EVERYTHING they state & claim to the public. 
For this reason and numerous others, this is why you should never assume people are ‘Guilty of a crime, because of what law enforcement says! Guilty or Innocent, is a verdict that the courts MUST decide on, based on all of the factual evidence presented in court. Because LE will make statements & claims to the public, without factual evidence to back it up. And this is critically important for people to remember. An accusation from LE against someone, is not evidence. But sadly in today’s world of social media, many young people hears these statements made by LE, and immediately start saying the accused is GUILTY, and will go so far to say “Death Penalty” for the accused, and usually will just say any kind of horrific torture need be applied against the accused! These people consider LE to be the investigator, the Judge, the Jury, AND the ‘hangman! And for those that have looked deeply into this and studied hundreds of cases, we see just how often that LE is WRONG, and we also see how LE very often chooses the easiest suspect to pursue, as their ‘main suspect’  even though there’s no evidence there. Then they’ll cherry pick evidence that can be applied to that ‘easy target’, and actually ignore evidence that points to someone else who would be harder to convict. Therefore they simply ignore that evidence. Once you fully understand that LE is first and foremost in the business of getting convictions, over four ending the actual truth, you then fully understand why you should never consider an accused person  (accused by LE) Guilty, of any crime!! Guilty or Innocent can ONLY be determined by the courts, AFTER ALL evidence by BOTH sides is presented! 
Our prisons are currently holding a large percentage of innocent people, precisely because of foolish people believing every word LE makes against an accused person because they were an easy target to prosecute. 
Lastly: What I’ve stated is a bold claim against the integrity of LE in general. And many will doubt this claim, believing LE is always 100% honest and working to find the truth in all cases. BUT, the statements I’ve made are backed by historical FACT. They’re not wild accusations just made by me! And ANYONE who wants to know more about this, or to see if what I say is true, can do so themselves just by digging in to the history of LE cases over the last 30 to 40 years. Unsurprisingly, before about 35 years ago, LE tract record was MUCH better, and they weren’t accusing innocent people like they do today, just because they’re easy to charge. 
So, in closing, I urge ALL to look into the historical facts about this.

I see it in video after video. And by doing that, he shows just how naive he really is. He constantly claims people are Guilty as charged, and does so LING before they even have their day in court!! It’s this naive attitude that has nearly already corrupted our justice system, trial by jury of our peers, so badly, that even an innocent person can have little faith in the courts to base their verdict on facts rather than hearsay started by LE. Because our entire justice system is built on the idea that jurors MUST enter a case, with the idea that ALL people are innocent UNTIL proven guilty by factual EVIDENCE and NOT guilty just because of claims made by LE. I just hope this problem can be fixed, but it’s hard to imagine that happening while we have social media where people constantly presume people are guilty just based on claims made by LE.
